title: Differentiation and Ordered Optimization in Banach Spaces
summary: In this paper, we will define generalized critical point, ordered extreme and order monotone property of single-valued mappings in partially ordered Banach spaces. In particular, we will find the explicit formulas of Gateaux and Frechet derivatives of some single-valued mappings on the Banach spaces lp, for and C[0, 1], such as polynomial type operators and trigonometric type operators.
